title: Local machine configuration
description: What differs per machine: the product checkout, worktree directories, AWS profiles and region, the asserted developer handle and the developer server ports. Untracked (gitignored); read from the primary checkout. Each value sits below a flag and an IDEA_REALIZATION_<KEY> variable and above the plugin option. A value that starts with REPLACE-WITH- counts as unset.

product_root.description: This machine's product checkout; an absolute path is clearest.

product_worktree_dir.description: Where product worktrees go, beside the product checkout.

worktree_dir.description: Where control worktrees go, outside the primary checkout.

aws_read_profile.description: AWS CLI profile for the sandbox's read-only role.

aws_deploy_profile.description: AWS CLI profile for the sandbox's deploy role.

aws_region.description: AWS region on this machine; overrides project.yaml aws.region.

handle.description: The developer handle this machine asserts; the git email must belong to it.

dev_port_range.description: Local ports a development server may use, as <first>-<last>.
